name: Marrow — Anonymous Reputation Attack Network
description: Marrow is an Underworld-adjacent anonymous board that specializes specifically in reputation warfare — leaked Meridian Score data, fabricated score manipulation evidence, real whistleblower documents about score-fixing, and coordinated campaigns to destroy or rehabilitate targets' social standing. Unlike the Ossuary's broad scope, Marrow is laser-focused on the reputation economy: it publishes stolen HR files, intercepted corponation performance reviews, evidence of Meridian Score manipulation by wealthy clients, and doxxed identities of score auditors. The platform is structured as a series of 'wards' — topic-specific boards — and is accessed through rotating Underworld addresses that change every 72 hours.
cultural_impact: Marrow has become a destabilizing force in M88's reputation economy — its exposure of Meridian Score manipulation by Tier 4-5 clients has eroded public trust in the system, while its own misuse as a targeted harassment tool has destroyed careers and lives in roughly equal measure. Corponation HR departments now routinely monitor Marrow for leaks, creating a surreal dynamic where the platform's audience includes the very institutions it attacks.
key_figures: Sable Ferreira-Osei (investigative journalist who uses Marrow as a source)
Ghost Auditor Collective (anonymous score-manipulation exposé group)
locations: Underworld — rotating addresses, no fixed location
Known access points in Shelf net cafes, Calumet District
Dead drops in Tier 2 transit hubs for physical data exchanges
story_hooks: A player character's Meridian Score drops 200 points overnight after a Marrow post claims they committed a crime they didn't commit — and tracing the fabricated evidence leads to a Tier 5 family whose patriarch they unknowingly insulted.

The Warden has announced they will publish a complete internal database of Meridian Score manipulation transactions — 40,000 entries spanning five years — unless a specific corponation meets their demands, and multiple factions want the player to either facilitate or prevent the drop.

A Marrow ward dedicated to exposing synthetic abuse begins receiving posts that are clearly from synthetics inside a closed facility — someone is leaking from inside and Marrow is their only channel out.
user_base: Estimated 400,000 active users; mix of genuine whistleblowers, investigative journalists, professional reputation assassins, and corporate intelligence operatives
monetization: No formal monetization; sustained by anonymous QUANTA donations and rumored funding from a Tier 4 faction using it as a destabilization tool against competitors
notable_feature: The Ward of Scales — a specific board where Meridian Score auditors are named, ranked by alleged corruption, and targeted with coordinated exposure campaigns, which has made score auditing one of the most dangerous white-collar professions in M88
